name: Galaxy Funfetti Cupcakes with Stars & Chocolate "Planets"

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Pilsbury Funfetti cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE CUPCAKES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two 12-cup muffin pans with paper liners and set aside. (Or bake in batches if necessary.)
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15.25 oz) box confetti cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Fill the muffin liners half-full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.

TO DECORATE THE CUPCAKES: Place frosting and food coloring in a clean medium bowl. Using the hand-held mixer, blend on medium until color is evenly distributed, about 1 minute. (Add more food coloring, if necessary, to reach desired color.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (16 oz) tub vanilla frosting
¼ tsp blue food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Transfer icing to a piping bag with a star tip.
Decorate cupcakes with icing, sprinkles, and coated chocolate candies to resemble "planets."
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rainbow sprinkles
⅓ cup chocolate candies

instructions.primary_message: Arrange decorated cupcakes on a platter and enjoy! If planning ahead, refrigerate the cupcakes and let them sit out at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before serving.
